title: Timeline cursors, positions, and generations above the largest safe integer passed the body checks, against the OpenAPI caps
resolution: Every cursor, position, and generation of a session read is a safe integer, cursors from 0 and positions and generations from 1; boundary tests at the maximum and one above.

title: An earlier read lowered the cursor by 100 after one page, so a short page skipped the turns up to the shown ones for good
resolution: The earlier read follows a short page's next cursor until it reaches the shown turns, with the loop guards, the one-read rule, and the overtaken-snapshot drop kept.

title: Every failed earlier read became the string failed, so a 403 with its role, a 404, and no answer showed the same notice
resolution: EarlierRead carries the ReadFailed; the page says why by failure kind, with the role a 403 names, and a retry.

title: A failed agent session list of the task detail did not say why: a 403 without a role, a 404, and no answer read alike
resolution: The list failure text is chosen by failure kind, with the role a 403 names kept through withRequiredRole.

title: Every applied event replaced knownAt, so a delayed event could move the last known time back
resolution: knownAt keeps the later of the snapshot's time and an event's; a new snapshot sets its own.

title: The missing-task notice interpolated runId and taskId without Breakable, so 128-character identifiers could overflow a phone width
resolution: Both identifiers of the notice render through Breakable, covered by a 128-character test.

title: The lowest read position was every record's freshness, so a replayed turn event between the session and turns reads overwrote a newer turn
resolution: The view keeps the freshness of the session and of each turn, the position of the read or event that supplied it; an event not above it is skipped, and an earlier page replaces a turn only when read above it.

title: Session events reset the board feed's resync delay and consumed its during-read cap, against decision Q8
resolution: startBoardFeed drops the session events before the core, so the board's reconnect accounting is unchanged; a separate test file checks the cap and the backoff.

title: Task 3.2 stayed unchecked although the route, the make verify run, and verification.md were recorded
resolution: Task 3.2 is ticked; the review, architect check, and archive tasks stay open.

title: An unreadable session frame was an anonymous resync, so the board feed closed its stream and read the board again for a frame it never showed
resolution: The resync of an unreadable agent-session-changed or turn-changed frame names the frame's event (unreadable); boardEventsOnly drops it, and the session feed reads again as for any resync.

title: The session feed passed board-changed and other runs' card-changed to the core, so they counted toward its during-read cap and reset its resync delay
resolution: sessionEventsOnly drops board-changed and a card-changed of another run than the session's before the core; a card-changed of its run still passes.

title: The Load earlier turns button unmounted while the window loaded, so the focus dropped to the body and did not return
resolution: The button stays mounted while it loads, saying so with aria-busy and a loader (none under reduced motion), so the focus stays on it; the feed ignores a repeated click.

title: MAX_PROJECT_PAGES bounded the agent session pages too through the shared readPages
resolution: MAX_PAGES names the limit of both lists, with MAX_PROJECT_PAGES kept as an exported alias so control-plane-board.test.ts stays unmodified.

title: The requirement said the first window is the turns before lastTurnPosition, which reads as excluding the last turn
resolution: The requirement says the up to 100 turns ending at lastTurnPosition (476 characters).

title: board/ imported agent-session-wire.ts and useCardSessions.ts from agent-session/, which imports board/: a cycle between the two folders
resolution: agent-session-wire.ts, session-labels.ts, and useCardSessions.ts moved under board/ beside board-wire.ts and board-labels.ts; agent-session/ builds on board/ and board/ imports nothing from it.
